title: MPB‑GraphFWPCA (override): λ=0.605, δ=0.105 (kd=20, k=48) — δ micro
abstract: δ micro‑adjustment around the best configuration. Fixed λ=0.605, kd=20, k=48, cosine, binary edges with true distances. Hypothesis: a slight increase to δ=0.105 may improve mixing without harming labels.

original_submission.content:
import sys
import anndata as ad
sys.path.append('storage')
sys.path.append('storage/praxis')
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca(
        adata,
        lam_override=0.605,
        delta=0.105,
        kdensity=20,
        k_total=48
    )
